description: Approved architectural inspiration sources for Context Foundry Roblox agents

patterns.description: Curated external repositories and concepts Roblox agents can adapt as architectural inspirations
concepts_to_extract: Server-authoritative systems: all state changes originate server-side; clients send intent only.
Service/controller architecture: encapsulate gameplay features in services with clear interfaces.
Module organization: shared modules in ReplicatedStorage, server-only in ServerScriptService, client in StarterPlayerScripts.
Persistence patterns: resilient DataStore usage with session locks, retries, and schema versioning.
Networking contracts: typed RemoteEvents/RemoteFunctions, rate limits, and explicit payload schemas.
State management: observable state with predictable updates, avoiding hidden globals and shared mutation.
Project structure and tooling: Rojo-aligned folder maps, CI formatting/linting, and test harnesses built with TestEZ.
adoption_guidance: Use these sources for structure and interfaces; adapt naming, logging, and safety checks to Context Foundry prompts.
Prefer extracting patterns (service lifecycles, request validation, module boundaries) over copying code.
Document chosen inspirations in design notes so builders and testers can align on expectations.
Keep toolchain parity with Rojo + Stylua + Selene + TestEZ to mirror upstream workflows and reduce drift.
